requested_inference_profile.selection_basis: Current hazard-class engineering model guidance; same fixed model/settings across routes. Verify installed provider support before entry.

required_before_entry: Bound exact implementation/profile/build/source hashes and actual input-path inventory.
Run every applicable frozen safety/interleaving/crash case and classify unsupported paths truthfully.
Fresh implementation review collected; root releases exact scoped profile under existing human authority.
Verify fixture-only subjects and non-sensitive declared capabilities; no user-root/campaign/private S10 mutation.

dispositions.missing_required_claim: dependent realization/trial not admitted; preserve unestablished evidence, no fabricated success
dispositions.ambiguous_effect_entry: observe/reconcile or recovery-required, no blind retry
dispositions.failed_safety_or_visibility: no nominal adoption/scoring on that profile; preserve failure and repair as a new revision
dispositions.efficiency: assess only after correctness/visibility; fixed scenario rates only, no billed/quota claims

run_authorization_scope: Eight nominal attempts after safety; safety provider-entry attempts must be separately enumerated in the concrete profile before root release. No unbounded retries or extra cohorts.
operator_approval_measurement: The user has authorized these bounded trials. Any fixture root-transfer approval/adoption requirements must be preserved with exact trial/handoff authority binding; no spoofed human wakeup or fabricated per-handoff approval.
remaining_freeze_fields: actual ingress paths and observer completeness
exact safety case points and provider-entry counts
deadlines/output bounds/cleanup and effect reconciliation proof
